qualification_slices.manual_release: Existing required PMT cases plus applicable PMT-25..36; no delegated-development prerequisite
qualification_slices.approved_worklist: Manual foundation plus exact finite-workset and autonomous successor cases
qualification_slices.delegated_development: Explicit qualified decision/grant support plus all delegation cases; mode alone is unsupported authority

nodes.delivery: Versioned project/readiness/change contracts and identity mapping
Consistent project roadmap snapshot and HTTP read projection
Source-backed lifecycle deltas, disposition-aware finding triage and advisory expectation refresh
Recommended versus committed order, exact approved worksets and versioned Business/Architecture decisions
Idempotent milestone projection through authorized EP repository delivery with separate runtime/repository freshness
Explicit bounded delegated project decisions without implicit approval or mandate expansion
Installed service, restart and separately scoped project-mode qualification

evidence_gates.requires: Qualified own HTTP operation/event/error/auth contracts; no full UI dependency
Existing intake, governance, progression, activation/claim/recovery and actual configured Mission capacity; no new scheduler
Qualified actual EP execution/receipt/capacity contracts for claimed behavior; no peer work allocation
Authorized bounded roadmap publication, protected delivery and exact operation readback; no Forge direct Git writer
Explicitly governed delegated decision roles, grants, exact subject evidence, remaining limits and mandatory human fences; no mode-implied authority

scenario_registry.requirement: Typed capability/Mission/Candidate/Expected/history groups, actual zero/one/multiple active work and no phantom Mission allocation
Frozen revision, distinct approvals, manual/automatic release, eligibility and active lifecycle remain orthogonal
M2 genuinely approved/released through real services before M1; current dependency evidence unlocks M2 once without owner relay
Expected or partially/unapproved Candidate never auto-starts; new Candidate still follows explicit real approvals
Predecessor COMPLETE without required artifact/review/deployment evidence does not unlock dependent work
Expiry, revocation, hold or policy change between eligibility and claim denies activation at the actual boundary
Routine source change revalidates assumptions without blanket reapproval; material scope change cannot reuse stale approvals
Priority and hard/speculative edges remain distinct; conflicting/cyclic/unresolved edge edits rejected; stable eligible tie-break
Duplicate/out-of-order completion and event delivery produce one reconciliation/context application and correct delta
Concurrent starters and lost acknowledgement preserve one activation/intake identity; uncertain EP POST is not resubmitted
Fresh process reopens pending, claimed, admitted and reconciled boundaries with same instance, authority and consumption
Cursor resync, mixed revisions, pagination, offline and source outage remain visibly stale/partial; stale command rejected
EP completion, Forge reconciliation and required human acceptance are independently represented
Expected added/split/merged/retired changes retain reasons and provenance; no silent overwrite of human/frozen work
Wrong project/actor/instance, confused-deputy requests, malicious content and secret-bearing links are denied/redacted
Read-only report and docs/design-only scope survive projection, successor and release; no automatic implementation expansion
Supported serial/concurrent limits preserved; unsupported multiplicity visible, no newly enabled parallel execution
Unknown estimates/usage/confidence remain unknown; no progress from changing Mission counts or invented deadline
Five locales, both themes, desktop/phone, keyboard/touch, stable detail links, selection and clipboard failures
Refresh/sort/open/reconnect issues zero planning, intake or EP mutation requests; closing Workspace does not stop Forge
Versioned hold/disarm/reorder/release commands show preview and actual readback; paused Forge does not cancel admitted EP work
Failed/ambiguous predecessor never grants new authority or fresh repair budget under a replacement Mission
Missing API/capability or peer outage has no CLI/import/SQL/Inbox/IPC fallback; read-only rollout labels unsupported controls
No remaining project gap yields bounded idle and no fabricated Expected/Candidate/Mission or extra provider call
Approval, dispatch, admission, running, blocked, failed, cancelled, partial delivery, reconciliation and acceptance remain distinct automatic facts
Authorized repository milestone projection preserves approved direction and separate freshness; duplicate, conflict or self-generated commit cannot start work
Out-of-scope reviewer findings create evidence-linked proposals, never new execution authority; urgent scoped stop is not permission to fix
A current acceptance defect cannot be hidden in a follow-up Candidate to claim success; governed repair or amendment remains required
Duplicate, rejected, deferred and accepted-risk findings preserve disposition; changed evidence may propose but not silently approve reopening
Human choice of any eligible authorized item may override the recommendation without bypassing dependencies; sorting never changes committed order
APPROVED_WORKLIST executes only exact approved released subjects under the committed selector; high-ranked new findings cannot join or reorder it
DELEGATED_DEVELOPMENT requires qualified explicit role grants and exact auditable decisions; mode selection never replaces mandatory human gates
Delegation scope, expiry, revocation and consumed limits survive successor Missions, restart and mode switch; unknown authority stops release
Priority and workset amendments bind exact revisions, impact and role decisions; stale or concurrent commands cannot broaden authorization
Single-Mission multi-Action proof cannot qualify the project loop or alter Mission 3 acceptance; qualification slices remain separate
Capability contribution and acceptance remain many-to-many and evidence-bound; completed Mission counts or published projections cannot prove product completion

ci_joins.inner: Reuse FCI real-service/installed harness and FIE-01..28; unchanged existing required cases and Mission 3 scope
ci_joins.outer: Extend FCO-FLOW/RESTART/NEGATIVE with PMT-03/04 and PMT-25..36 without replacing FOE-01..10; qualify each declared project mode separately
ci_joins.browser: Workspace own API/Playwright, five locales, both themes; real producer subsets, no internal eligibility stub

completion_note: All applicable required PMT cases and owning subset evidence must pass for the claimed slice; documentary completion is not runtime or project-loop qualification and activates no policy.
